description: The pages of the main window and of the task windows may run operations of the catalog through `op`, receive change events through `subscribe`, signal their first screen, check spelling in the editor, attach files the person chooses or drops (the page names the task, never a path), open or save a copy of an attached file through the system, open a task in its own window, set their title, and move, minimize, maximize and close their own window, for the header bar. Nothing else of Tauri's API is reachable from the page.
